description: Telekomunikacijski razvodni ormarići is a dataset listed in DATA - City of Zagreb, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.arcgis.com. A telecommunication distribution cabinet is a distribution node that is the point of concentration of the cables of the light distribution network on the one hand and the access distribution cables of the interconnection network on the other. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Telecommunication junction boxes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infrastruktura, GeoHub, telekomunikacijski ormarići. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, SHP, GEOJSON, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-grad-zagreb.
